purpose: Answer whether the current v048 land-hardware/process layer should improve Japanese ground exchange ratios in Five-Go, without applying a blanket multiplier or inventing Phase III-A casualties.
hardware_reservation_status: The current land-hardware reservation explicitly leaves most prior ground events uncorrected event-by-event; Bengal/Arakan and Tarawa have been scoped exceptions. Five-Go has not yet received that event-local correction.

phase_I.reason: Prepared artillery/ammunition QC, tactical communications, engineer/vehicle uptime and recovery are more useful on the North China/Guanzhong road-rail axes than a theater-wide scalar, but Chinese retreat preserves much of the field army.

phase_II.reason: Mountain/Cinling terrain down-rates vehicle/direct-fire gains; artillery/communications/engineering still produce a modest exchange improvement.

working_event_local_correction_if_applie.confidence: LOW_MEDIUM; this is a bounded working correction pending phase-by-phase event reconstruction

phase_III_A_guangyuan.rule: Do not fabricate a casualty number. Reconstruct the late-Sep/Oct to late-Oct/early-Nov 1943 Hanzhong-Guangyuan fighting separately before producing a full 1943 China casualty total.

strategic_interpretation: Yes, v048-style land re-audit likely raises the Japanese ground exchange ratio modestly. The larger branch damage to Chongqing still comes from loss of equipment/stocks/nodes, degraded transport/fiscal base, western force fixation and recurring air/logistics taxes rather than a dramatic multiplication of Chinese bodies lost.
